opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until November 28, 1988, within which to pay *940the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

opinions.author: Brennanmarshallstevens
opinions.text:
Justice Brennan, Justice Marshall, and Justice Stevens,

dissenting.

For the reasons expressed in Brown v. Herald Co., 464 U. S. 928 (1983), we would deny the petition for writ of certiorari without reaching the merits of the motion to proceed informa pauperis.
